## WorldOptions.skyboxUri property

The URI of the skybox cubemap for the world. Use `skyboxes/procedural` for the procedural sky renderer, optionally with `?weather=cloudy|overcast|storm` and `?precip=rain|snow`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
skyboxUri: string;
```
